title: A Practical SAFE-AI Framework for Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises Developing Medical Artificial Intelligence Ethics Policies

bias_targets.methodology: The paper proposes the SAFE-AI framework, which recommends defining fairness metrics to detect disparate impacts by evaluating model performance, error rates (false positives/negatives), and access to beneficial outcomes across various demographic subgroups such as race, gender, age, or geography.

As a concrete application of the framework, the authors provide a methodology card for minimizing gender bias, which involves conducting distribution analyses of records per gender in the raw training data and validation sets, checking predictive accuracy for each gender, and analyzing the distribution of the final system impact/outcomes across genders.
